approve_with_nits
Move the new lifecycle parameter details into the API table.
AWS's lifecycle documentation supports the microVM/session correction.

findings.checklist_item: Keep the main text about ideas: parameter names and configuration ranges belong in an API details table.
findings.title: Move lifecycle configuration details into the API table
findings.claim: The new correction embeds the parameter name and its configuration range in the explanatory prose, despite the existing API table immediately below.
findings.evidence: The note introduces `maxLifetime` with the parenthetical 'also 1 minute to 8 hours; the idle timeout cannot exceed it'. The table at lines 646–647 includes the identifier but omits its configurable range and the relationship between the settings.
findings.proposed_change: Describe the configurable maximum microVM lifetime in plain words in the note. Add an AWS-labelled table row containing `maxLifetime`, its 60–28,800-second range for microVMs, and the constraint that the idle timeout cannot exceed it. Preserve the session-resumption and ephemeral-state explanation.
